name: Surviving Purge
storyline:
In the year 2120, Earth has become uninhabitable, forcing humans to live in Purge, a floating city in the sky. This city is divided into seven districts, each home to a different tribe: goblins, orcs, centaurs, wolfmen, minotaurs, gargoyles and reptilemen. The superior humans, at the top of the hierarchy, dominate the tribes and the inferior humans, who live in the sewers.

The seven tribes have been confined to the city to manufacture spaceship parts, unaware of the superior humans' plans to abandon them on Earth. Achilles, an inferior human, discovers this plan and decides to save his people, triggering a series of alliances, betrayals and rivalries among the tribes. With the help of loyal friends like Hiro and Rogan, he embarks on a desperate quest to put an end to the "Alpha human" mission and preserve the future of all the tribes.
